units.source_text: 我女儿叫真砂，刚满是十九岁。

en.t: My daughter's name is Masago, and she has just turned nineteen.

units.source_text: 她巾帼不让须眉，是个要强的好姑娘。

en.t: She is every bit as strong as any man, a fine girl with a determined spirit.

units.source_text: 她只有我女婿一个男人，没有恋爱史。

en.t: The only man in her life has been my son-in-law; she has no romantic history.

units.source_text: 她瓜子脸，微黑皮肤，左边眼角有一颗痣。

en.t: She has an oval face, slightly dark skin, and a mole at the corner of her left eye.
